task.title: Build your first LinkedIn carousel
task.description: Turn one college project into a clear, useful carousel that shows what you built and what you learned.
task.whyItMatters: Great work deserves a visible story. A thoughtful post helps recruiters and peers understand your skills beyond a resume.

build.description: One LinkedIn carousel that tells the story of a project in a way a recruiter can scan.
build.expectedOutput: A published LinkedIn carousel + the project repository or source link.
checklist: Choose one project, event, or assignment you are proud of
Create 4–6 simple slides in Canva, Figma, or Google Slides
Explain the problem, your approach, and one result or learning
Export your carousel and publish it with a short LinkedIn caption

guidance: Keep one idea per slide—clarity beats fancy design.
Use a real screenshot or small code snippet as proof.
End with what you would improve next time.

task.title: Set up your public learning log
task.description: Create a simple place to track the projects, ideas, and lessons you will share during this challenge.
task.whyItMatters: A visible record makes your progress easier to reflect on and easier for recruiters to understand.

build.description: One simple learning log in Notion, GitHub, or a document you will update daily.
build.expectedOutput: A shareable link or first entry that states what you plan to build.
checklist: Choose a place to keep your 60-day learning log
Write one goal for the challenge
Add your first short entry and share it

guidance: Keep it simple enough to update after a busy college day.
Write what you built and one thing you learned.
Progress matters more than a perfect first post.
